# Rokib Al Dhin Raadh

Independent AI researcher in Dhaka, Bangladesh. 18. No university, no advisor, no lab, no external funding. I build interpretable, self-correcting AI architectures that challenge the black-box paradigm.

## Key Projects

- **ORMAS — self-correcting neural architecture.** Three-signal training (global backpropagation + per-node local loss + health-gated autonomous self-correction). It detects structural failures mid-training and repairs them without stopping and without a human. 383 controlled experiments across 4 architectures on a single RTX 3090. +70.3pp recovery gap over compute-matched baselines after a dead-layer lesion where every standard baseline collapses permanently to chance. Carries the first formal local stability characterization for any self-correcting architecture, adapted from Sontag's Input-to-State Stability framework in control theory; global convergence remains an open problem. Submitted to AAAI 2027, preprint on Zenodo.
- **OXIMO — cognitive multi-agent operating system.** Agents decompose tasks, hire the specialists they need, and carry memory between sessions. 40,933 lines of production code across 11 mini-repos, 2,011 tests, zero failures, rebuilt from a 106,000-line monolith at 72% fewer lines.
- **Black Bloxie LTD — controlled test environment.** A UK Companies House-registered company that exists to be an experiment; every operational role is held by an AI agent. A 12-month injection-removal-reinjection lesion study: removing the system collapsed commercial output 91% simultaneously across every channel, re-injection recovered 1,300%. Scale is capped deliberately — no jurisdiction currently assigns commercial liability to an autonomous agent.

Together the three are called **OXIDO**: ORMAS is the immune system, OXIMO is the operating system, Black Bloxie is where both get tested against real customers, suppliers, and regulators.

## The Journey

- Self-taught programmer from age 12.
- Five ventures between ages 12 and 17, each failing at a structurally different layer. The convergent finding: the bottleneck is never individual capability, it is always coordination. That finding produced OXIMO; OXIMO's need to learn from adversarial production data produced ORMAS.
- At 15, sold a stock market prediction system for roughly $10,000 USD. That funded the RTX 3090 that ran all 383 ORMAS experiments.
- At 17, registered Black Bloxie LTD and derived the ISS local stability characterization.
- Currently pursuing fellowships and institutional support to scale to Transformer-scale validation (ORMAS-T) and to get the ISS result in front of control theorists.

## Honest Limitations

The stability result is local, not global. It has not yet been peer reviewed by a control theorist. ORMAS is validated on CNNs and DAGs only. A two-layer CIFAR-100 lesion recovers only 7.4%. GlassBox provides structural telemetry, not semantic interpretability. OXIMO currently runs on external API-based LLM providers. The Black Bloxie deployment is research-grade by design: 396 paying customers across 10 countries.
